UPDATE bear_job_runs
            SET state = $2,
                started_at = CASE WHEN $2 = 'running' THEN COALESCE(started_at, NOW()) ELSE started_at END,
                finished_at = CASE WHEN $3 THEN COALESCE(finished_at, NOW()) ELSE finished_at END,
                updated_at = NOW()
            WHERE id = $1
